in_hebrew.name: תפיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: God is my embellishment, God is my beauty, It is derived from the Hebrew word 'toph', which means 'adornment' or 'ornament'. The 'i' at the end is likely an El-suffix, indicating 'my God'.

in_greek.name: Θεοφια
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Tiffi in Greek is Θεοφια (Theophia), which means 'God-loving'. It is derived from the Greek words 'theos' (God) and 'philia' (love).

in_latin.name: Theophia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Tiffi in Latin is Theophia, which also means 'God-loving'. It is derived from the Latin words 'deus' (God) and 'amor' (love).
